title: pgrls configuration
description: Configuration file (pgrls.toml) for pgrls, the Postgres Row-Level Security linter. Rule reference: https://github.com/pgrls/pgrls/blob/main/docs/RULES.md

extends.description: Path, or list of paths, to base pgrls.toml file(s) merged beneath this one. Later list entries and this file's own keys take precedence.

url.description: Postgres connection string. $VAR and ${VAR} are interpolated from the environment. Prefer leaving this unset and passing --database-url (or $DATABASE_URL) at runtime so secrets stay out of version control.

fail_on.description: Severity that makes `pgrls lint` exit non-zero. CI gates on this.

disable.description: Rule IDs to disable entirely (case-insensitive), e.g. ["SEC022", "PERF002"].

rules.description: Per-rule settings, keyed by rule ID — e.g. a [lint.rules.SEC001] table.

extra_rules.description: Dotted Python module paths that expose additional project-specific rules via a `RULES` attribute (loaded by pgrls.rules.load_extra_rules). Each entry is a non-empty importable module path, e.g. ["mycompany.pgrls_rules"]. Built-in rules always run; these run alongside them, and their IDs become usable in `disable` and [lint.rules.<ID>].

fail_on.description: Change classification at or above which `pgrls diff` exits non-zero.

rename_detection.description: How `pgrls diff` reports a renamed policy. 'strict' collapses a name-only rename; 'relaxed' also collapses a rename+edit (graded); 'off' keeps drop+add. A detected rename is reported as a DIFF_POLICY_RENAMED change; the old and new policy names appear in the human-readable message field (no separate structured old-name field yet).

rename_classification.description: Classification for a name-only policy rename.

strict_binding.description: Scaffold policies that compare against a raising binding helper (pgrls_require_<label>) instead of current_setting(..., true), so a query on a connection that never bound a tenant errors instead of returning an empty result. Same as `pgrls generate --strict-binding`.

severity.description: Remap this rule's emitted severity without disabling it (promote an info nudge to a CI-blocking error, or demote a noisy warning).

allowlist.description: Objects exempt from this rule. Entry shape depends on the rule: a policy ID (schema.table.policy), a table reference (table or schema.table), a role name, a qualified view/function, etc.
